newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Soccer-Venables selects 26-man World Cup qualifying.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Venables selects 26-man World Cup qualifying.

text.p: Australia national team coach Terry Venables has selected a 26-man squad for the Oceania zone World Cup qualifying group, starting next week.
Australia must overcome Solomon Islands and Tahiti in their group before a likely play-off against New Zealand over two legs.
The winner must beat an Asian country in a final qualifier to reach next year's World Cup in France.
Goalkeepers - Mark Bosnich, Zeljko Kalac, Jason Petkovic
Defenders - Matthew Bingley, Robbie Slater, Alex Tobin, Tony Vidmar, Milan Ivanovic, Steve Horvat Tony Popovic, Craig Moore, Robbie Hooker, Kris Trajanovski, Kevin Muscat,
Midfielders - Stan Lazaridis, Craig Foster, Ned Zelic, Robbie Enes, Josip Skoko, Aurelio Vidmar
Forwards - Damian Mori, Paul Trimboli, John Aloisi, Graham Arnold, Ernie Tapai, David Zdrilic
